clips.title: The story
paras: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear keeps the Trollplow ready for battle. Known as “Stone,” the dwarf mechanic and driver serves in the Ironforge Siege Brigade, working to improve the engine's performance and armor. Travelers in Dun Morogh help him find rare materials for the war machine.

At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear drives for Ironforge's Siege Brigade. His pride is Trollplow, a heavy siege tank built to break enemy lines. He knows a driver's life in battle depends on sound gears, strong plates, and steady steam pressure. So he keeps refining the tank's fighting power and making its cramped cockpit more livable.

Pilot Stonegear spends his time off duty debating engineering plans with fellow pilots such as Pilot Bellowfiz. He is never content with the depot's standard designs. To improve Trollplow's armor and munitions, he seeks unusual ores and volatile minerals. Travelers venture through Dun Morogh's snowy wilderness and dangerous caves to find the supplies he needs.
